doc_sources.title: FastAPI
doc_sources.rationale: The official documentation site fastapi.tiangolo.com is the primary entry point for FastAPI docs, matching the preferred source hierarchy. It is the root landing page, not a deep link, and is directly owned by the project.

doc_sources.title: Qdrant Documentation
doc_sources.rationale: The Qdrant documentation site (https://qdrant.tech/documentation/) is the official first‑party documentation hub for the Qdrant vector search engine and includes sections for the Python client. It is the root landing page, matching the preferred source type. The GitHub repo is a fallback but the docs site is more appropriate as the canonical entry point.

doc_sources.title: Elasticsearch Python client documentation
doc_sources.rationale: Read the Docs site is the official documentation for the Python client, directly maintained by Elastic and provides the full API reference and usage guides. It is the primary entry point for the library's docs.

doc_sources.title: Celery Documentation
doc_sources.rationale: The root of the official documentation site (docs.celeryq.dev) is the primary entry point for Celery's docs, matching the highest priority rule. It is the current stable docs host and not a third‑party source.

doc_sources.title: SQLAlchemy Documentation
doc_sources.rationale: The docs.sqlalchemy.org site is the official documentation root for SQLAlchemy, matching the preferred first-party docs source. It is the main landing page for the current version (2.0) and is directly linked from the project's homepage.

doc_sources.title: aiosmtplib documentation
doc_sources.rationale: Read the Docs site is the library's own documentation host and serves as the primary entry point for users. It is directly linked from the project and is the most authoritative source.
